subject: Enhancing Flowtron's 2026 Mosquito Control Catalog
body:
Hi Mark,

I am writing to you from our mosquito killer lamp factory. Since 2020, we have focused exclusively on Solar-Powered Mosquito Solutions.

In a market where customers are increasingly looking for energy-efficient and cordless options, our 2026 solar range offers:
- 4500V High-Voltage Grid (Industrial grade)
- IP65 Waterproofing for all-weather outdoor use
- Auto-Cleaning Technology to reduce maintenance

We currently support several top Amazon/eBay sellers with reliable, stable supply chains.

Could I send you our 2026 Wholesale Catalog to see if there's a fit for your current procurement needs?

Best regards,

[My Name]
XPES Factory Team
